# Icon (`icon`)

Small tintable symbol frame.

| | |
|--|--|
| **IR kind** | `icon` |
| **Constructor** | `Icon(…)` |
| **Child-flex props** | Yes (when parent is `layout`) |

> Distinct from `IconRef` (asset value) and token type `Icon`.
